title: I'm More Bullish on Kaspa Than I've Ever Been
description: $KAS sits around 85% below its all-time high, and I am more bullish than I have ever been because of what just went live on the network.

I walk through the Toccata hard fork, the first smart coins, the Igra and Kasplex Layer 2s, the targets of 25 to 40 and then 100 blocks a second, and why I think we are still early with around 96.8% of all $KAS already mined.
